the problem of compensating for the output of projectors in non-ideal lighting conditions, so that the final image is perceptually uniform and of high quality.
the problem of producing a compensation image to be displayed on a projector that produces the desired appearance when viewed under varying ambient lighting conditions.
the problem of how to compensate for irregularity in the output of a digital projector, and we present a framework for doing this.

the method presented here provides a good balance between the quality of the compensation and the amount of dynamic range that is sacrificed in the process, and that it can be used to compensate for the output of projectors in a wide variety of situations.

content-based compensation is feasible for projectors, and can be performed in a robust manner that can handle the wide variety of real situations that are encountered.
